capabilities: Create an XDG autostart entry for Obsidian
Launch Obsidian with a hidden-start flag
Check the local tray host via gdbus
Remove the autostart entry when disabled
disambiguation: Not a tray plugin itself; it only registers a login autostart entry and requires Keep Open in Tray for hiding.
extras: Linux only, tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Writes faust-obsidian-start-in-tray.desktop outside the vault in the XDG autostart directory; no network access. Setting labels are in Russian with English in parentheses; README is bilingual English/Russian. Turn the setting off before uninstalling to remove the startup entry.
intentEvidence: Enable Keep Open in Tray and make sure the system tray is available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to launch minimized into the system tray when the Linux desktop session starts.

relations.evidence: Enable Keep Open in Tray and make sure the system tray is available.

summary: Plugin that starts Obsidian hidden in the Linux system tray at desktop login by adding an XDG autostart entry.
